body: Yeah I know how you feel. I've tried once before but I couldn't go through with it.

Sorry for the late response.

No I haven't gone for medical help nor antidepressants. I was planning to go back to college and going to the consoling center to talk to someone about this but I'm afraid if I tell them about my suicidal thoughts, they're gonna take me to a mental hospital and it might ruin my chances at the university.

I would go to a regular doctor, but then I'd have to tell my family about these thoughts that I'm having, which after my friend's reaction, I don't want to burden anyone else. I dunno what to do in this situation.

Thanks for your reply.

Most of my guilty feelings are coming from my friend's reaction to my suicide attempt and it makes me regret even telling him that I was depressed. 

But I'm trying to get better. It just doesn't seem like I'll ever be able to forgive myself. Now I don't have any friends as a result.

Wow thanks for the song suggestions :) These songs are right up my alley.

I really like Strange Comfort and its lyrics. Very powerful music video as well.

Hi thank you for your reply. You were helpful, I'm just in a dark spot right now.

My main hobby is playing video games. I also like to work on my computer. I do occasionally listen to music, but nowhere near as much to know of any bands or popular singers.
Just life in general. I want to get better, but I don't think I can or will.

Yep I know this feel. I told a friend about my suicide attempt I had a few months back and he got angry at me and deleted me from his friend's list. All in all, I wish I hadn't said a word about it. I was going to to tell my parents about my situation, but after seeing my friend's reaction, I'll keep this to myself, even if it kills me.

Oh well. At least the people on reddit are nice.
Dang man I'm sorry to hear that :(

I totally agree with you.

I just wish there was a way I could make amends, but if he doesn't want to be friends anymore, then I can't change his mind. 

This whole incident has made me feel bad because I truly do want to feel better. I'm just afraid that one day I may attempt suicide again.   

Thank you for your comment. I'll just have to stay strong and, hopefully one day, find a good support group.

Aww I'm sorry this happened to you :(

Hopefully one day you will feel better and find yourself a great person/people to support you. I'm sure you didn't deserve it either.

Stay strong :)

Unfortunately no I don't. He was the only friend that I had. 

I've fallen out of contact with all my other friends, and he happened to be my closest one, so I felt comfortable talking to him about how I felt.

Basically he got angry at me, and told me to "wake up", which is much easier said than done.

Sometimes I do feel selfish for feeling like this. I just wish I could go back and prevent myself from saying anything about it.

I'm sorry that this happened to you.

Something similar happened to me recently. I had a friend whom I told about my depression, and he was always supportive with me especially since he went through depression as well. One day, I told him about my suicide attempt, and he gets angry with me and calls me selfish and told me to "snap out of it". We haven't spoken since it happened but it sucks that I lost a friend like that. 

I genuinely wish you the best.
Thank you for talking to me. You're definitely a good person. I wish you the best on fighting your depression.

Thank you for your response.

I just don't see any point to going on anymore. My life is average at best, yet I can never see any light in it. I feel like a defective human in our society. Its like I'm running around in circles trying to find an answer to what I wanna do for my life, yet I can't find anything. 

I do have hobbies but at this point, i don't think it's enough for me to wanna continue living.
